Eli (Finance): Heads up — Customer OmegaMed flagged a miscoded platform fee on their private deployment renewal invoice (INV-2026-1122). Platform fee recorded under 'private_onprem' but contract references 'private_vpc'. Appears to be a mapping mismatch; charge amount correct but SKU label wrong. Customer requested a corrected invoice for compliance.

Nora (Billing): Can you confirm invoice lines? Need to know if it's just a label or if different pricing applied.

Eli (Finance): Snippet from invoice XML: 
```
<invoice id="INV-2026-1122">
  <line sku="private_onprem" desc="Platform fee (annual)" amt="$55,000"/>
</invoice>
```
Contract: CO-OM-2024 references sku 'private_vpc' and platform fee $55k.

Pri (Sales Ops): We did a SKU consolidation in Nov 2025 where we aliased private_vpc -> private_onprem for internal catalog reasons. Billing mapping should have kept canonical sku on invoices, but looks like the alias slipped through. Customer needs canonical sku string for audit. They don't want a price change, just corrected taxonomy.

audit-bot: Note: invoices used for customer compliance audits must match contract SKU strings. Flag=Y.

Kai (Eng): Investigating. Billing exporter uses the product_catalog.name field if present; alias was mistakenly set as preferred name. I'll patch exporter to prefer canonical_sku when contract_linked=true. Filed BILL-9144.

Nora (Billing): Because amount is unchanged, we can issue a tax-neutral replacement invoice with corrected sku label. Process: create CN reversing INV-2026-1122, then create INV-2026-1122-R with identical amounts but corrected sku string. Need Sales + Finance approval to proceed.

Eli (Finance): Approve. This is a labeling correction only. No refund required.

Pri (Sales Ops): Approve. Confirm we include a short cover note to customer "SKU label corrected to match CO-OM-2024; no change to amount or payment due."

Zoe (Customer Success): Customer prefers we add "for audit" in the invoice memo. Also asked that we share the internal ticket number for traceability.

Nora (Billing): Will create CN-2026-0056 and replacement INV-2026-1122-R today and apply payment. Memo: "SKU label corrected to 'private_vpc' per CO-OM-2024; no amount change; see BILL-9144." ETA 24h.

Kai (Eng): Will ensure BILL-9144 includes a regression test and that catalog aliasing doesn't change invoice names going forward.

Eli (Finance): Thanks. Closing note: this is a good reminder to add a SKU-to-contract mapping verification step into the renewal checklist.

Nora (Billing): Done — replacement invoice created and payment applied. CN-2026-0056 attached. Marking resolved.
